text:
GENERATE BURST K1p-adv-01 — the Keeper's ADVANCED gear set on the SAME woman (ledger R-31/R-32; Run C-3 fork C): TWO candidate stills. task_id "K1p-adv-01".

Make TWO separate image_gen calls, each editing/redrawing Image 1 so that EVERYTHING stays exactly the same — face, hair, skin, pose, framing, standing height, the ivory shirt, navy tabard, strap, olive satchel on her LEFT hip, belt, bracers, trousers, boots, the walnut staff shaft in her RIGHT hand, the #00ff00 plate, the painted register and the light from screen upper-left — EXCEPT two additions: (1) the STAFF HEAD becomes a small brass ASTROLABE: two or three nested open brass rings on a short collar at the very tip of the staff with a thin pointer arm across them — a working instrument, not a ring-with-hour-mark, no glow; (2) a chestnut-leather PAULDRON with brass edging sits on her LEFT shoulder (on the SCREEN-RIGHT side of her body, since she faces the camera), carrying Image 2's emblem as a small brass plate, clearly legible, upright. No other insignia anywhere; the tabard chest stays plain. Candidate 2 may vary only the astrolabe ring count and pauldron size slightly. Portrait canvas like Image 1 (1024×1536); do not matte.

ONE retry only if a result mirrors her (staff in the wrong hand), moves the pauldron to her right shoulder, changes her face, or goes off-plate — name the reason. Copy the outputs to out/adv_1.png and out/adv_2.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1p-adv-01"; images = both files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (direction S) — identity, pose, framing and register to preserve exactly
the provenance mark to place on the pauldron (shape only)
